INSERT INTO checkpoint_processing_status
                (checkpoint_id, status, events_processed, processed_at, updated_at)
            VALUES ($1, 'COMPLETED', $2, $3, $3)
            ON CONFLICT (checkpoint_id)
            DO UPDATE SET
                status = 'COMPLETED',
                events_processed = $2,
                processed_at = $3,
                updated_at = $3
